extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: we have to build an economy that works for everyone, not just those at the top

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: we need new jobs, good jobs, with rising incomes

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: I want us to invest in you

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: I want us to invest in your future

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: That means jobs in infrastructure, in advanced manufacturing, innovation and technology, clean, renewable energy, and small business

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: most of the new jobs will come from small business

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: I also want to see more companies do profit-sharing

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: If you help create the profits, you should be able to share in them, not just the executives at the top

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: And I want us to do more to support people who are struggling to balance family and work. I’ve heard from so many of you about the difficult choices you face and the stresses that you’re under. So let’s have paid family leave, earned sick days. Let’s be sure we have affordable child care and debt-free college. How are we going to do it? We’re going to do it by having the wealthy pay their fair share and close the corporate loopholes.

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: Our jobs are fleeing the country

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: You look at what China is doing to our country in terms of making our product

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: we have a very good fight

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: we have a winning fight

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: we have to stop our jobs from being stolen from us

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: We have to stop our companies from leaving the United States and, with it, firing all of their people

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: All you have to do is take a look at Carrier air conditioning in Indianapolis

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: So many hundreds and hundreds of companies are doing this

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: We cannot let it happen

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: We have to renegotiate our trade deals

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: we have to stop these countries from stealing our companies and our jobs

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: Under my plan, I’ll be reducing taxes tremendously, from 35 percent to 15 percent for companies, small and big businesses. That’s going to be a job creator like we haven’t seen since Ronald Reagan. It’s going to be a beautiful thing to watch. Companies will come. They will build. They will expand. New companies will start.

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: I think that trade is an important issue

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: we have to trade with the other 95 percent

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: we need to have smart, fair trade deals

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: the kind of plan that Donald has put forth would be trickle-down economics all over again

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: it would be the most extreme version

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: That is not how we grow the economy

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: And so what I believe is the more we can do for the middle class, the more we can invest in you, your education, your skills, your future, the better we will be off and the better we’ll grow.

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: So we have to do that

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: We have to renegotiate our trade deals

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: And, Lester, they’re taking our jobs, they’re giving incentives, they’re doing things that, frankly, we don’t do. Let me give you the example of Mexico. They have a VAT tax. We’re on a different system. When we sell into Mexico, there’s a tax. When they sell in—automatic, 16 percent, approximately. When they sell into us, there’s no tax. It’s a defective agreement. It’s been defective for a long time, many years, but the politicians haven’t done anything about it.

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: But in all fairness to Secretary Clinton, when she started talking about this, it was really very recently. She’s been doing this for 30 years. And why hasn’t she made the agreements better? The NAFTA agreement is defective. Just because of the tax and many other reasons, but just because of the fact…

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: They should have been doing this for years

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: we owe $20 trillion

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: We cannot do it any longer

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: The companies are leaving

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: I could name, I mean, there are thousands of them

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: our politicians never do this

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: they have special interests

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: the special interests want those companies to leave

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: in many cases, they own the companies

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: we can stop them from leaving

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: We have to stop them from leaving

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: Nine million people—nine million people lost their jobs

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: Five million people lost their homes

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: $13 trillion in family wealth was wiped out

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: we have come back from that abyss

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: it has not been easy

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: the last thing we need to do is to go back to the policies that failed us in the first place

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: I intend to get it done

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: we will have 10 million more new jobs

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: we will be making investments where we can grow the economy.

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: Independent experts have looked at what I’ve proposed and looked at what Donald’s proposed, and basically they’ve said this, that if his tax plan, which would blow up the debt by over $5 trillion and would in some instances disadvantage middle-class families compared to the wealthy, were to go into effect, we would lose 3.5 million jobs and maybe have another recession.

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: Take clean energy. Some country is going to be the clean- energy superpower of the 21st century.

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: Donald thinks that climate change is a hoax perpetrated by the Chinese. I think it’s real.

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: That was a disaster

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: They lost plenty of money on that one

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: Our energy policies are a disaster

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: Our country is losing so much in terms of energy, in terms of paying off our debt

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: We have to do a much better job at keeping our jobs. And we have to do a much better job at giving companies incentives to build new companies or to expand, because they’re not doing it. And all you have to do is look at Michigan and look at Ohio and look at all of these places where so many of their jobs and their companies are just leaving, they’re gone.

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: The biggest one, a multinational one known as CAFTA, I voted against

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: I hold the same standards as I look at all of these trade deals

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: When I was secretary of state, we actually increased American exports globally 30 percent. We increased them to China 50 percent

extraction_items.speaker: CLINTON
extraction_items.text: I know how to really work to get new jobs and to get exports that helped to create more new jobs

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: NAFTA is the worst trade deal maybe ever signed anywhere, but certainly ever signed in this country

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: now you want to approve Trans-Pacific Partnership

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: You were totally in favor of it

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: if you did win, you would approve that, and that will be almost as bad as NAFTA

extraction_items.speaker: TRUMP
extraction_items.text: Nothing will ever top NAFTA

tagging_items.speaker: CLINTON
tagging_items.quote_text: I want us to invest in you. I want us to invest in your future.

tagging_items.speaker: CLINTON
tagging_items.quote_text: I want us to invest in your future.
